# LinkedIn / Personal Website Draft

## Short version

I built an interactive Quant Interview Trainer using Streamlit.

It turns my quantitative finance interview notes into a searchable question bank with derivations, formula sheets, Python coding examples, quiz mode, review mode, and exportable quiz results.

Topics include probability, statistics, derivatives, Greeks, stochastic calculus, time series, machine learning, numerical methods, and risk management.

## Medium version

I recently built an interactive Quant Interview Trainer in Streamlit.

The goal is to turn static quant interview notes into a practical active-recall tool. The app includes a searchable question bank, formula sheet, coding examples, hidden-answer quiz mode, self-assessment, review mode, and CSV/JSON export of quiz results.

Current topics include:

- Probability and brainteasers
- Statistics and estimation
- Time series and forecasting
- Machine learning for quants
- Derivatives and Greeks
- Stochastic calculus
- Python coding and numerical finance
- Risk measures and backtesting basics

This project combines my interests in quantitative finance, option pricing, stochastic calculus, programming, and interview preparation.
